raw_text: r/netsec — Recorded Future just dropped their RedEcho report and the IOCs are really interesting. ShadowPad C2 domains resolving to AXIOMATICASYMPTOTE infrastructure. Here are the key indicators: 5 DDNS domains used for C2, IPs in 154.210.x.x range. The targeting is very specific — 4 out of 5 Regional Load Despatch Centres which control the power grid in real-time. This is pre-positioning, not espionage. If they wanted data they would have exfiltrated and left. Instead they maintained persistent access for months.
